answer.rationale: The brief states that this part carries no load, so there was nothing to be uncertain about.

brief: A PLA L-bracket 40 mm wide, made of 5 mm thick plate. The base leg is 50 mm long and lies flat; the upright leg stands on the back end of the base and is 40 mm tall overall. Two 5 mm holes pass through the base, 20 mm apart across its width, centred 25 mm from the front end. Two 5 mm holes pass through the upright, 20 mm apart across its width, centred 25 mm above the bottom. It carries no load, so there is no load case.

intent.summary: A PLA L-bracket made of 5 mm thick plate with dimensions 40 mm wide, 50 mm long base leg, and 40 mm tall upright leg. It has two 5 mm holes on the base and two 5 mm holes on the upright, both 20 mm apart and centred 25 mm from the respective edges. The part carries no load.

note: requirements: the record as the run accepted it -- no claim on the part's height; `hole_distance` and `hole_distance_upright` both 20 mm. The answer is the designer's, returned identically twice: the upright a second box lying flat inside the base, all four holes down Z at the base's height (one off the part, the upright's pair in the base), nothing welded or wired, `hole_distance_upright` never declared.
